topic: Time Limit Exceeded (TLE) in Code Execution
content: Our online compiler enforces a 2-second timeout per test case for Python and Java, and 1 second for C++. If a user experiences TLE, advise them to optimize their algorithm complexity (e.g., from O(n^2) to O(n log n)) or check for infinite loops.
